newsitem.title: USA: Intl Alliance to buy Zelenkofske-Axelrod.
newsitem.headline: Intl Alliance to buy Zelenkofske-Axelrod.

text.p: International Alliance Services Inc said Monday it will acquire Zelenkofske-Axelrod and Co for a maximum of $5,700,000 cash and $8,500,000 payable in International Alliance's common stock which will be restricted for two years.
International Alliance expects the deal to close June 30, subject to final due diligence.

Zelenkofske-Axelrod has an existing client base in excess of 1,500 businesses and individuals throughout the United States and International Alliance expects the acquisition to add in excess of $14,000,000 to its annualized revenues.
Zelenkofske-Axelrod is an independent accounting firm based business service provider in the metropolitan Philadelphia area and provides outsourcing services.
International Alliance is a provider of integrated business services through its IASI Business Services Group and of niche market insurance products through its IASI Insurance Services Group.
